name: OGSpy Development Environment
postCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y libpng-dev libonig-dev libxml2-dev libzip-dev zip unzip mariadb-client && docker-php-ext-install mbstring xml bcmath gd && pecl install xdebug && docker-php-ext-enable xdebug && echo 'xdebug.mode=debug,coverage' >> /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/docker-php-ext-xdebug.ini && echo 'xdebug.start_with_request=yes' >> /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/docker-php-ext-xdebug.ini && echo 'xdebug.client_host=host.docker.internal' >> /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/docker-php-ext-xdebug.ini && echo 'xdebug.client_port=9003' >> /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/docker-php-ext-xdebug.ini
